name: io.github.dfch/biz-dfch-bpmnmcp
title: BpmnMcp
description: A Model Context Protocol (MCP) server for agent-and-human BPMN 2.0 process modeling.

environmentVariables.name: BPMN_MCP_DOCS_DIR
environmentVariables.description: Documents root, resolved against the working directory; registered BPMN processes live under its prc subdirectory.

environmentVariables.name: BPMN_MCP_LOG_FILE
environmentVariables.description: Rolling log file base path (no extension), relative to the working directory.

environmentVariables.name: BPMN_MCP_LOG_LEVEL
environmentVariables.description: Minimum pino log level: fatal, error, warn, info, debug, or trace.

environmentVariables.name: BPMN_MCP_LOG_ROTATE
environmentVariables.description: Log rotation frequency: daily, hourly, or a numeric string read as a number of milliseconds.

environmentVariables.name: BPMN_MCP_LOG_RETAIN
environmentVariables.description: How many log files to keep in total, the active file included.
